hero.sub: Hi, I'm Thomas. I ship modern web & mobile products end-to-end — from idea to staging to scale. Three years deep in React, Next.js and Node, coding by the ocean in Gran Canaria.

services.d: Custom Next.js & React applications with auth, dashboards, payments, real-time data — built fast, shipped clean.
Node + Postgres APIs, AWS deploys, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, CDN/caching. Boring stuff that doesn't break at 3am.
Cross-platform React Native apps, on the App Store and Play Store, with offline mode, native modules, and OTA updates.
Lighthouse 95+, Core Web Vitals fixed, technical SEO, GA4 + GTM dashboards. Sites that show up and load faster than the competition.
Sanity Studio integrations so non-technical teams can publish without breaking the build. Editor-first content models.
GSAP, Three.js and Framer Motion when the brief calls for delight, not just function. Used responsibly.

process.d: 30 minutes, no pitch deck. We talk about what you need, what's done, what's blocking. I tell you if I'm the right fit.
I send a written scope, milestones, and a fixed timeline within 48h. Clear deliverables, clear price, no surprises.
Weekly demos on a staging URL. You see progress every Friday and can redirect at any point. Slack/email async, calls only when useful.
Production deploy, DNS cutover, analytics dialed in. I run a 7-day burn-in to catch what only real traffic can show.
30 days of bugfixes & small adjustments included. After that, retainers or per-feature — whichever you prefer.

testimonials.q: Thomas turned a vague brief into a live product in six weeks. He pushes back when needed, and that's exactly what we wanted.
We told him 'make it feel premium', and he did. Sanity, motion, performance — all dialed.
Reliable, fast, and actually fun to work with. Async communication, weekly demos, no drama.

about.body: I started in hospitality (kitchens in Australia, cabin crew at Ryanair, sales at GoDaddy) before code grabbed me and didn't let go. Career-changer, self-taught into bootcamp into shipping production every week. I work remotely with teams across Europe.

facts.v: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria · ES

faq.a: Usually 1–2 weeks notice. For tight launches I sometimes have a slot sooner — ping me.

faq.q: Do you work solo or with a team?
faq.a: Both. I work full-time at Galaga Agency and take selected freelance projects alongside. For bigger scopes I plug into your team or bring trusted collaborators.
Project-based, fixed-scope quotes. I send a written estimate within 48h after the discovery call. Day-rate available for retainers.

faq.q: Can you maintain an existing project?
faq.a: Yes — audits, refactors, takeovers from previous devs. I'll tell you honestly if it's salvageable or if we should rebuild.

faq.q: Where are you, and which timezones do you cover?
faq.a: Las Palmas, Spain (UTC+0 / WET). I overlap with most of Europe and the East Coast US comfortably.

faq.q: Do you write code, or oversee?
faq.a: I write the code. Every line. I'm the person you Slack at 2pm and the same person who deploys at midnight.

contact.body: Tell me what you're cooking. I read every message myself. If we're not a fit I'll tell you within a day and point you somewhere good.
